raw_reasoning:
Enabling an opt-in default for personalized recommendations in the EU affects users’ preferences and how their content is selected, which is plausibly tied to privacy/data processing expectations. Because the proposal is explicitly to use an opt-in default (rather than forced personalization), it suggests consent would already be required, and users would reasonably expect to be asked before personalization starts. However, the prompt doesn’t specify what happens to users who haven’t opted in (e.g., whether they receive non-personalized content), so I can’t be fully certain.
